# Zhishang (Dongguan Zhishang Technology Co., Ltd.)

> Zhishang is a Dongguan, China manufacturer of glue dispensing and gluing machines for packaging and box production: hot melt and cold glue application, inline gluing lines, and custom non-standard gluing machines built to order. The site is available in English and Chinese (Chinese pages under /zh/).

## Products

- [All Products](https://zhishangkj.com/products/): Full product range, English and Chinese.
- [Custom Automated Meal Box Gluing Machine](https://zhishangkj.com/products/custom-automated-meal-box-gluing-machine/): Fully enclosed cabinet conveyor line with a multi-axis gluing head for automatic cold-glue application on paper meal boxes.
- [Inline 4-Axis Glue Spraying Machine](https://zhishangkj.com/products/inline-4-axis-glue-spraying-machine/): Inline multi-axis glue spraying line.
- [Box Punching Ribbon Machine](https://zhishangkj.com/products/box-punching-ribbon-machine/): Box punching and ribbon machine.
- [ZS-S088A](https://zhishangkj.com/products/zs-s088a/) / [ZS-S088A-R](https://zhishangkj.com/products/zs-s088a-r/): S088A series gluing machines.
- [ZS-S088B](https://zhishangkj.com/products/zs-s088b/) / [ZS-S088B-2-R](https://zhishangkj.com/products/zs-s088b-2-r/): S088B series gluing machines.
- [ZS-S088C](https://zhishangkj.com/products/zs-s088c/) / [ZS-S088C-4](https://zhishangkj.com/products/zs-s088c-4/): S088C series gluing machines.
- [ZS-S088D](https://zhishangkj.com/products/zs-s088d/) / [ZS-S088D-4](https://zhishangkj.com/products/zs-s088d-4/): S088D series gluing machines.
- [ZS-S088E-4](https://zhishangkj.com/products/zs-s088e-4/): S088E-4 gluing machine.
- [ZS-S088P](https://zhishangkj.com/products/zs-s088p/): S088P gluing machine.
- [ZS-S088R-3](https://zhishangkj.com/products/zs-s088r-3/) / [ZS-S088R-4](https://zhishangkj.com/products/zs-s088r-4/): S088R series gluing machines.
- [ZS-YH4040](https://zhishangkj.com/products/zs-yh4040/): YH4040 machine.
- [CS4539](https://zhishangkj.com/products/cs4539/): CS4539 machine.
